observations: body L1-L5: the end of the survey of p. IX: the head «Stellae fixae:» is italic, at the left margin; L5 continues the entry of L4 with a deeper indent.
body L3, L5: the hyphens of «144-177» and «178-186» are of the thinner sort (4.0 and 4.1 pt long, 1.1 and 1.2 pt thick), that of «274-277» of the thicker (3.7 pt long, 1.7 pt thick); see p. IX.

body L6, L11, L12, L14, L15, L17: broken letters: the o of «Quo», the v of «brevior» (printed like a 7), the o of «animo» and of «viros», the o of «Knobel» and the r of «Taurinensi»; a tick over the u of «plus» is a speck, not a diaeresis; the first e of «debebam» prints filled.

body L20-L22: the signature: «CAROLUS ALPHONSUS NALLINO» in capitals of a lighter face, and below it Nallino's title in two lines of a smaller bold type, centred on the right half of the page; the lines are set at their printed centres, the name in the roman of the text and the title in bold.
body: a closing rule, 102.2 pt long and 0.72 pt thick, centred on the measure, stands 124 pt below the signature; printed broken in two places, it is drawn whole.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
